to: everyone near the character (`xy_emit`): players and observers

fields.name: name
fields.description: The emote: `G.skills[skill].emote`. In G it is the same as the skill name, for example `"wiggle"`.

fields.name: player
fields.description: The character that used the emote.

fields.name: target
fields.description: The target character. Absent when the emote has no target (node/server.js:10079).

fields.name: variation
fields.description: A random variation of the animation.

confirm.note: `target` is `target && target.name`; `target` is a player or undefined (node/server.js:9898-9922; the emote skills in G target `player`), so the key is absent, never null

senders.what: The `skill` handler: a skill with `emote` in `G.skills`
